verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a RESTful API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt file and the markdown versions of doc pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
